title: WIBTA if I asked the girl sitting next to me on the bus to stop talking on the phone?
question: WIBTA if I asked the girl sitting next to me on the bus to stop talking on the phone?
body: I’m currently on the bus home, and I’m about 2 hrs into a 6 hour ride. The girl sitting next to me has been on the phone this whole time. She hasn’t been particularly loud or anything, and it’s not like calls aren’t allowed on the bus, but it’s really starting to get on my nerves. WIBTA if I asked her to stop?
